column1: # Load-bearing behaviours that must not be lost to a later edit.
# Each row asserts a rule still lives somewhere in the plugin.
#   - a deleted source (CLAUDE.md, fable-mode) whose behaviour we absorbed, where
#     no original is left to diff against;
#   - `audit`, for rules added to close a defect found in review, where the whole
#     point is that the defect stays closed.
# Checked by scripts/check-coverage.sh. Patterns are FIXED SUBSTRINGS, not regex.
# Whitespace is normalised first, so line-wrapped prose still matches.
